---
title: Dashboard
format: dashboard
---
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(scales)
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)

cong_by_cd <- read_rds("gerrymandering-JreamIT/data/cong_2024_district_results.rds") |>
  mutate(
    winner = if_else(dem_2party_share>0.5,"DEM","REP"),
    margin_pct = (dem_2party_share - 0.5)*100
  )

total_dem_votes <- sum(cong_by_cd$dem_votes)
total_rep_votes <- sum(cong_by_cd$rep_votes)
total_votes <- total_dem_votes + total_rep_votes

statewide_dem_share <- total_dem_votes / total_votes
statewide_rep_share <- total_rep_votes / total_votes

seat_counts <- cong_by_cd |> count(winner)
num_districts <- nrow(cong_by_cd)
dem_seats <- seat_counts$n[seat_counts$winner=="DEM"]
rep_seats <- seat_counts$n[seat_counts$winner=="REP"]

cong_by_cd |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(as.factor(cddist), dem_2party_share),
    y = dem_2party_share,
    fill = winner
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format())

competitive_tbl <- cong_by_cd |>
  filter(abs(margin_pct) <= 5) |>
  transmute(
    District  = cddist,
    Dem_share = round(dem_2party_share*100,1),
    Margin    = round(margin_pct,1),
    Winner    = winner
  )

competitive_tbl
